page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.12xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.c8i server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 48 physical cores, meaning hyperthreading is disabled with 1.0 thread per core. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants on the KVM hypervisor.

The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. This configuration is tailored for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The ecs.c8i.12xlarge does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating efficient data transfers and communication within the cloud environment.

The qualitative cost profile of this instance reflects its compute-focused design, offering high CPU density and dedicated core performance at the expense of local storage and high memory-to-CPU ratios. The lack of bundled local storage requires users to factor in the latency and cost of external block storage. This instance is suited for compute-intensive workloads such as high-performance web serving, batch processing, scientific modeling, and distributed analytics where raw CPU execution speed and dedicated core allocation are prioritized over large memory capacities.
